title: feat(app-shell): Studio empty states carry the primary action (objectui#12514)
body:
Fixes #12514
Clause-②: no

## What changed

One shared block, `StudioEmptyState` (beside the panels in `studio-design/`): the surface's icon, one sentence, and a primary button. Its button never invents a create path. It opens or runs exactly what the existing "New" or rail "+" does.

**Target 1: one centered block per empty surface**
- Validations, Actions: an object with none shows the block in place of the list card and the editor card. "New validation rule" / "New action" opens the very presets menu the list header's "New" opens: one Popover element, whose trigger is the block's button while the object holds none. Once the first item lists, the menu hands focus to the header's "New", which keeps objectui#11861's focus contract now that the opening trigger is gone.
- Hooks: "New hook" runs the header's own `addHook`. A save error still shows above the block.
- Automations: "New automation" and the rail "+" both call `openCreateFlow`, the rail's former inline `onAdd`, now a named const. Same `CreateItemDialog`. In the package-less scope the block carries the existing `engine.studio.org.none` sentence and no button.
- Access: "New permission set" and the rail "+" both call `openCreateSet`. Same dialog, same unsaved-edits guard.

**Target 2: nothing to select, nothing shown**
- Validations, Actions, Automations and Access already open their first item, so their "Select…" sentences could only show when empty or loading. Those sentences retire.
- The Automations aside is not drawn while the package holds no flow. With a flow open, the "Click a node on the canvas…" prompt stays, because there are nodes to click.
- Hooks does not auto-select, so with hooks listed and none picked, "Select a hook to edit it." stays: there is something to select.

**Target 3: the rail names its control**
- `engine.studio.auto.none` now reads "No automations yet — click “+” above to create one". `engine.studio.access.none` reads the same for permission sets; it used to say "create one below", the wrong direction.
- On a read-only package (or the package-less automation scope) there is no "+", so the rail says nothing and the block's sentence stands alone. The objectui#12453 posture already says read-only; no second note is added.

**i18n (en and zh)**
- Retired: `engine.studio.rules.pick`, `engine.studio.rules.explain` (the one-sentence ruling), `engine.studio.actions.pick`, `engine.studio.auto.pick`, `engine.studio.access.pick`.
- Added: `engine.studio.rules.newButton`, `engine.studio.hooks.newButton`, `engine.studio.actions.newButton`, `engine.studio.auto.emptyMain`.
- Reworded: `engine.studio.auto.none`, `engine.studio.access.none`, and `engine.studio.access.emptyMain` (now the neutral "No permission sets in this package yet.", shown without a button on a read-only package).

Existing `data-testid`s are unchanged. New ones: `rules-empty`, `rules-empty-new`, `hooks-empty`, `hooks-empty-new`, `actions-empty`, `actions-empty-new`, `auto-empty`, `auto-empty-new`, `access-empty`, `access-empty-new`.

## Deviations

- None of the three panels opens a create dialog. Validations and Actions open a presets popover, and Hooks creates at once. The block opens or runs exactly those, which is the ruling's "same handler".
- Five existing pins read the retired paths and were updated, 1–3 lines each: `ObjectValidationsPanel.presets-11861` and `ObjectActionsPanel.presets-11861` (open the menu from the block while empty), `StudioDesignSurface.changesCount-11787` (click the rail "+" by test id, since the block's button shares its name), `StudioDesignSurface.packageLessFlows-11553` (the sentence is the block's now), and `studioAutomationCopy.plainLanguage-11659` (`auto.pick` swapped for `auto.emptyMain`).

## Test evidence (HEAD `b780c69`)

- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell test`: Test Files 1412 passed, 1 skipped (1413); Tests 13479 passed, 9 skipped (13488); exit 0.
- New: `StudioEmptyState.panels-12514.test.tsx` (12 tests) covers each panel's block, its button opening the header's menu or running its New, the focus handoff, read-only, and a control. `StudioDesignSurface.emptyStates-12514.test.tsx` (6 tests) covers Automations and Access: the block, no aside, the rail sentence, the button and the rail "+" opening the same dialog, and read-only.
- Ablations, one per new pin, each red then restored to an empty `git diff HEAD`: the Hooks button's onClick, the Validations focus handoff, the Automations button's onClick, the Automations aside guard, the Access button's onClick, and the read-only rail condition.
- `type-check` 0 · `build` 0 · eslint on touched files 0 errors, warning counts equal to main's · `check:i18n-keys` 0 · `check:i18n-drift` 0 · `check:i18n-dead-keys` 0 · `check:i18n-designer-parity` 0 · `check-changeset-presence` 0 · `check:new-line-citations` 0.

## Acceptance notes

- After a create started from the block in Hooks, Automations or Access, the block's button is gone once the first item lists, so focus has no trigger to return to. Validations and Actions hand it to the header's New; the other three are left as they are.
- Hooks keeps "Select a hook to edit it." while hooks are listed and none is picked, because Hooks is the one tab that opens no item by itself.

Implemented in session `https://claude.ai/code/session_018bpaEyeyB1SYJHvDWsn4pG`.
